title: The Grave Robbers
text: A gang of living thieves is digging into a barrow by the light of a stolen lantern, with a great deal of rope and a great deal of nerve. They do not stop when you arrive. They offer you a cut, and keep glancing at the barrow's door.

options.label: Take the cut and help them dig. The dead are past caring.

outcomes.text: The barrow is rich, and its keeper is away. For now.
The barrow's keeper is home, and it has been listening to the digging, and it is ready.

options.label: Run them off. The dead deserve their rest.

outcomes.text: They run, cursing. The barrow is quiet, and seems to thank you.

options.label: The sharpest watches from a distance, to learn what lives in the barrow.

outcomes.text: Something comes out of the barrow. The thieves do not. You learn a great deal about what lives there.
